candidates.quote: Declarant shall rent sixteen (16) of the sixty-four (64) homes at Larkspur Commons as restricted homes.
A restricted home may be rented only to a household whose income does not exceed fifty percent of area median income.
The total of rent and tenant-paid utilities for a restricted home may not exceed thirty percent of the income limit for that home.
These covenants bind Declarant and all later owners of the property.
Declarant shall give the Village a list of the restricted homes, the household incomes and the rents charged by March 1 of every year.
